This ranking maximizes my chance of getting my highest value school (z) while also giving me a good shot at my second highest (x).

The deferred acceptance algorithm guarantees stability, meaning no student-school pair would both prefer to be matched with each other rather than their current matches.  My high priority at z gives me the best chance, even with competition.

My next best option is x, as it has the next highest value ($71) and I also have the highest priority there (rank 1).  Following that, y ($64) and then w ($57).

Therefore, my ranking should reflect my values while acknowledging the general applicant preferences. I'm betting on my high priority at z and x to outweigh the general preference for y.
